name: Xinh's Clam & Oyster House
why: Permanently closed. Owner Taylor Shellfish's own post says the restaurant's last day was October 29 after 20 years (2016, per the post's search listing; the page itself shows no date). The listed website xinhsrestaurant.com now redirects to an unrelated gambling site. Chef Xinh Dwelley later helped open The Fjord Oyster Bank in Hoodsport (2022), which is in the guide.
